question: An ability says 'Exile this creature at the beginning of the next end step.' If the permanent is no longer a creature at that end step, is it still exiled?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it is exiled even if it is no longer a creature, as long as it is still on the battlefield.
expected.answer: An ability that reads “Exile this creature at the beginning of the next end step” will exile the permanent even if it’s no longer a creature during the next end step. However, it won’t do anything if the permanent left the battlefield before then.
